findings.description: The new code includes every Argument in the help output. Arguments whose `hidden` attribute is set are not filtered out, and `Argument` has no `hidden` handling in this `get_help_record`. A hidden argument therefore shows up in the Positional arguments section.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command declares `click.Argument(..., help=...)` or any documented argument alongside a hidden one. Mechanism: the fallback `(arg.make_metavar(ctx), "")` is applied to any argument whose `get_help_record` returns None, with no hidden check. Impact: help output lists arguments the author meant to hide. Confidence is moderate because Argument's hidden support is not shown in the diff.
